title: Lead, Procurement
description: THE OPPORTUNITY Work-Model: Hybrid Employment Type: Full-Time Role type: Maternity Cover Contract duration: 12 Months Reporting to the Head, Procurement, the Lead, Procurement is responsible for driving measurable procurement value through expert negotiation, advanced analytics, and deep procurement systems expertise. The role integrates category strategy, supplier relationship management, analytics, and technology enablement to support value for money, governance, sustainability, and risk management across the Foundation’s multi-country operations. If you are a seasoned procurement specialist and possess professional maturity and sensitivity with different cultures looking to increase your impact, read on! WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE Lead complex, multi-country supplier negotiations and contracting activities. Collaborate to develop and execute global and category-level procurement strategies. Develop customer-centric (end-user) end-to-end procurement process. Design and maintain procurement analytics, dashboards, and performance frameworks. Provide data-driven insights to support sourcing, governance, and decision-making. Oversee supplier performance management, supplier relationship management frameworks, and contract lifecycle management (CLM). Ensure compliance with policies, delegated authorities, and audit requirements. Progress integration of principles such as ESG, ethical sourcing, and inclusiveness into procurement sourcing strategies. Continuously review processes, systems, and procedures for all areas of responsibility by studying workflow, sequence of operations, roles, turnaround times and requirements to improve operations and service for all areas of responsibility. Prepare and present analysis regarding value for money and efficiencies. WHO YOU ARE Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain, Analytics, Finance, or related field. Professional certification preferred (MCIPS, CPA/ACCA, CSCP). 10 years of progressive experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, analytics, or category management. Demonstrated expertise in negotiation, supplier governance, and value delivery. Strong experience with ERP Expertise in procurement platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP Ariba, Coupa, etc). Advanced procurement analytics and cost modeling. Deep procurement systems and sourcing technology expertise. Contract negotiation and supplier performance management. Proficiency in ERP software like Workday (ERP), Service Now and Microsoft Excel and other relevant digital tools. Familiarity with best-in-class contract life cycle and risk management systems Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities. Impeccable integrity that exemplifies the Foundation’s values. Flexible, adaptable, and able to execute a range of job duties and changing priorities. Possess excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to articulate information to a variety of constituents across cultures. The annual salary for this position is within the range of $125 000 to $140 000 (CAD) commensurate with experience, skills, and internal equity considerations. ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN RECRUITMENT The Foundation uses artificial intelligence (AI)–enabled tools to screen, assess, and/or select applicants for this position including, but may not be limited to, the use of AI-assisted resume screening and assessments to support the initial stage of the recruitment process. Applications of qualified candidates, as identified by the AI tool, are reviewed by representatives of the Foundation before shortlisting for an interview. ACCOMMODATION The Foundation is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive recruitment process and workplace. If you require accommodation due to a disability or any other protected ground under applicable legislation during any stage of the recruitment process, please let our recruitment team know by contacting us at: humanresourcesmastercardfdn.org . We encourage candidates to make their accommodation needs known so that we can provide equitable opportunities. Information relating to the need for accommodation and accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially. Mastercard Foundation (the “Foundation”) values and respects your privacy. By submitting an application for this opportunity, you hereby agree to the Foundation’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal information in accordance with its Privacy Policy (available at https://mastercardfdn.org/privacy/). Please note that the Foundation may share your personal information with third-party agencies that support the Foundation’s recruitment activities, and such third-party agencies may contact you directly regarding this opportunity. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the Foundation’s Privacy Officer at the address indicated in its Privacy Policy. title: Lead, Technology Business Partnering
description: THE OPPORTUNITY The Lead, Technology Business Partnering, will report directly to the Head, Technology Business Partnering, and will play the critical role of a dedicated business partner to the Mastercard Foundation’s functions, enabling value and impact. This candidate should have a deep understanding of the Foundation’s initiatives across Africa and Canada and is responsible for ensuring that technology solutions support and enhance the Foundation’s impact. WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE Serve as a liaison for the Programs and/or Supporting functions assisting in engagements, meetings, and ceremonies to ensure alignment with the Foundation’s technology strategy. Provide operational support to the Head in fostering collaboration with Senior Leadership, and other key stakeholders. Support the implementation of technology initiatives that address the functional team’s needs, identifying gaps and recommending improvements. Facilitate the involvement of relevant cross-functional stakeholders in the co-creation and design of technology solutions. Track and report on the status of the technology initiatives across the many functional areas, ensuring progress aligns with defined goals and timelines. Provide regular updates to the Head and relevant stakeholders. Support the establishment of governance processes and frameworks to streamline collaboration between the Programs and supporting functions’ teams, and the Technology function. Ensure adherence to agreed decision-making processes. Conduct business analysis to identify opportunities for leveraging technology to enhance program outcomes. Stay informed about emerging technologies and assist in their application to drive efficiency and impact. WHO YOU ARE Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or Management, or a related field. Master’s degree or MBA is an asset Relevant professional qualification. Member of a relevant professional body. Proven experience (10 years) in Technology, Program Management, Business Relationship Management, Business Partnering, or a similar role, with previous leadership roles held. Familiarity working with enterprise SaaS platforms such as Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow. Experience in sectors such as international development, philanthropy, or emerging markets is an asset Solid understanding of how technology enables business process execution and improvement and the ability to recommend appropriate and relevant technology solutions to business problems. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex digital concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze data, identify trends and insights, and make data-driven recommendations. Understands how emerging technologies and service providers can be utilized to improve existing processes and increase operational efficiency. Demonstrates strong negotiation skills in complex environments with an aptitude for diplomacy. Possess excellent communication (written & verbal) and presentation- skills with the ability to articulate information to a variety of constituents across cultures. Intellectually curious and flexible, is comfortable with ambiguity, receptive to new ideas and open to change, when presented with best options. Possesses a global mind-set and professional maturity and demonstrates sensitivity to working within different cultures. A team player who can work in a fast paced, ever-changing environment. Possess professional maturity, sensitivity with different cultures, and impeccable integrity. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build consensus, influence stakeholders, and communicate effectively across all levels of the foundation. Demonstrated commitment to the Foundations equity, inclusion, and social impact values, with a passion for driving positive change and empowering underserved communities globally. The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone.
